cohort: Frozen local archive cohort; development role from existing split; all four opening-time core features observed
protocol_refinement: Added a current-version four-variable control after initial development diagnostics to separate vintage from feature-count differences; still exploratory, not independent confirmation
fold_strategy: Identical GroupKFold neighborhood assignments for every feature set and closure rule
parameter_strategy: Existing fixed base XGBoost AFT parameters; 200 rounds; no search or early stopping
primary_metric: Interval negative log likelihood, compared only within an identical target and cohort
secondary_metrics: Resolved-subset three-year Brier with unresolved counts
stage_two: Full 1000-property prospective scenario checks, not observed customer demand or success validation
